text:
Aisha Chen: Quick sync — Acme pilot requests private VPC deployment with HSM for PII data. Need product + eng + runtime + infra + security alignment on scope, launch gates, and ownership. Proposed target: 2024-10-10 (2-week sprint). Who's in?
Tom Nguyen: I can cover runtime changes (model variant + quantization profile). Need to know max seq len and expected qps.
Maya Patel: Infra: we'll need a dedicated subnet + NATing to Acme's peering. Estimate 3 infra days for VPC + routing + prewarm; depends on capacity allocation.
Jorge Ruiz: Security: HSM integration (KMS handshake + audit trails) is non-negotiable. I need a threat model and key rotation policy. Can product confirm data residency rules?
Aisha Chen: Acme requires EU-only data at rest, HSM-backed keys, and 99.9% availability SLA during business hours. They want canary in region-1 first.
Priya Singh: Oncall/obs: we'll need tracing and token-level cost telemetry enabled from day 1. Can runtime emit per-request trace id?
Tom Nguyen: Yes, will add trace header support (x-rd-trace). Also need to know if we should enable prefix KV caching for pilot. It speeds tokens but impacts memory.
Aisha Chen: Start with caching off for safety; we'll look at perf after canary.
Liam O'Connor: Can we map owners & gating checklist here? Quick suggestion:
```
- Owner: Product (Aisha)\n- Runtime lead: Tom\n- Infra lead: Maya\n- Security lead: Jorge\n- Obs/oncall: Priya\n- Program: Liam\n- Gate 1: HSM + KMS integration tested in staging\n- Gate 2: VPC peering + routing validated\n- Gate 3: Canary traffic (5%) for 48h with SLA met\n- Rollback plan: fallback to hosted variant if latency > 300ms p95\n```
Maya Patel: That checklist is good. One add: capacity pin (GPU reservation) for the canary window, otherwise noisy neighbors might throttle.
Jorge Ruiz: Also add compliance signoff: legal + security review completed before canary. I can start the docs but need sample data classification from product.
Aisha Chen: I'll share the Acme data classification doc by EOD.
Priya Singh: Can we get a rough capacity/throughput target? Acme expects 200 req/s peak for initial rollout.
Tom Nguyen: 200 req/s 8k tokens average -> we'll need batching + 2x concurrency headroom. Runtime estimate: ~2 mid-size GPUs for canary.
Maya Patel: Infra estimate matches: reserve 2 GPUs + one hot spare. I'll add a reservation request to the on-prem pool.
Liam O'Connor: Scheduling: if we start prep this week (config + KMS hookup), can we hit the 10 Oct tentative date?
Tom Nguyen: Tight but doable if security can sign off in 5 days.
Jorge Ruiz: I'll prioritize the review but need the classification doc first.
Aisha Chen: Sending doc now. Can everyone ack availability for a 30m sync tomorrow 11am PT to lock owners and timeline?
Priya Singh: Ack.
Tom Nguyen: Ack.
Maya Patel: Ack.
Jorge Ruiz: Ack.
Liam O'Connor: Ack.
deploy-bot: Reminder: next infra maintenance window is 2024-10-08 02:00-04:00 UTC — may overlap with prewarm.
Aisha Chen: Noted — can we avoid prewarm during that window, Maya?
Maya Patel: We'll schedule prewarm for 2024-10-09 morning instead.
Aisha Chen: Great. I'll create a follow-up checklist and invite the 11am sync. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
